mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE subject AS (SELECT a.id FROM iam_session_grant g JOIN iam_account a ON a.id = g.account_id WHERE g.token_digest = #{digest} AND NOT g.revoked AND g.expires_at > clock_timestamp() AND a.enabled AND a.credential_version = g.credential_version), requested AS (SELECT code FROM iam_permission WHERE scoped AND code IN #{code}), effective (id, depth) AS (SELECT id, 0 FROM iam_org_unit WHERE parent_id IS NULL AND enabled UNION ALL SELECT u.id, e.depth + 1 FROM iam_org_unit u JOIN effective e ON u.parent_id = e.id WHERE u.enabled AND e.depth < 1000), grants AS (SELECT rg.role_id, rg.permission_code, rg.scope FROM subject s JOIN iam_account_role ar ON ar.account_id = s.id JOIN iam_role r ON r.id = ar.role_id AND r.enabled JOIN iam_role_grant rg ON rg.role_id = r.id JOIN requested q ON q.code = rg.permission_code), member_units AS (SELECT m.unit_id AS id FROM subject s JOIN iam_membership m ON m.account_id = s.id JOIN effective e ON e.id = m.unit_id), subtree (id, depth) AS (SELECT id, 0 FROM member_units UNION SELECT e.id, t.depth + 1 FROM iam_org_unit u JOIN subtree t ON u.parent_id = t.id JOIN effective e ON e.id = u.id WHERE t.depth < 1000) SELECT 'SUBJECT' AS kind, NULL::varchar AS permission, NULL::bigint AS unit_id FROM subject UNION ALL SELECT 'PERMISSION', code, NULL::bigint FROM requested UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT scope, permission_code, NULL::bigint FROM grants WHERE scope IN ('ALL', 'SELF') UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 'UNIT', g.permission_code, m.id FROM grants g CROSS JOIN member_units m WHERE g.scope = 'DEPARTMENT' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 'UNIT', g.permission_code, t.id FROM grants g CROSS JOIN subtree t WHERE g.scope = 'DEPARTMENT_AND_DESCENDANTS' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 'UNIT', g.permission_code, gu.unit_id FROM grants g JOIN iam_role_grant_unit gu ON gu.role_id = g.role_id AND gu.permission_code = g.permission_code JOIN effective e ON e.id = gu.unit_id WHERE g.scope = 'CUSTOM_DEPARTMENTS'
